title: Complete durable operator controls
objective: Implement and test the missing operator-control vertical slice: objective revision history, pause-after-current completion behavior, watch status, and evidence-based telemetry.
scope: operator CLI controls and their deterministic tests
minimal lifecycle/status corrections directly required by those controls

may: inspect this repository and current tests
modify local CLI, state, pipeline, and Runner modules
modify package scripts only if necessary
may_not: modify .opsle runtime authority, policy, requirements, or evidence
invoke any AI provider from tests
deploy, merge, push, or create a PR
add a scheduler, web UI, or global supervisor

relevant_context: .opsle/specification.md DS-022, DS-023, DS-024, DS-031, DS-032, DS-042, DS-069, DS-081, DS-082, DS-083
Status and watch output must be deterministic and consume no model inference
Pause after current must not cancel a running child and must stop the next launch
Objective changes preserve prior revisions and reconcile active work by pausing rather than guessing
expected_deliverable: Focused operator-control implementation and deterministic tests.
expected_evidence: objective show/set CLI preserves immutable revision history and emits an event
objective redirect while work is active pauses automatic progression and surfaces reconciliation
pause --after-current allows the running attempt to finish then leaves supervisor PAUSED
status --watch is a deterministic terminal display with no model invocation
status exposes measured duration/output/reduction/route facts without inventing unavailable metrics
acceptance_criteria: objective revisions are durable and prior text remains unchanged
active-work objective redirects fail safe by pausing future progression
pause-after-current does not kill current work and becomes PAUSED after completion
watch status has a bounded testable interface and no provider dependency
telemetry uses measured durable values or explicit unknowns
prohibited_actions: canceling work as an implicit pause side effect
